## What

A Codex PreCompact `continue:false` ends the native turn so Papercusp can carry it. The QUEUED acknowledgement is admission, not delivery. Read the exact owner's `~/.papercusp/psu-pty/<owner>.events.jsonl` and its `homeEnsureFailure` before naming the cause. Different failures share the same visible hook message.

WI-6554700010051289 reproduced two current compatibility defects on 2026-11-17. A live isolated child (`su-2239fab3-759a-41b8-a75e-1a8b0a19ec30`, ADV 3) ran in `.papercusp-server-isolated/su-codex-homes/session-3` without `PAPERCUSP_SU_CODEX_HOMES_DIR`; later repair compared it with the desktop root and refused `scope/foreign-home` before making a request. Another owner (`su-ca7447a7-d0b8-4064-a282-5ae8b4e3a10c`, ADV 62174) received HTTP 200 from its older home writer at 11:07:56.655Z, but its generated hooks omitted the installed provenance hook, producing `home-hooks/managed-turn-enrollment-incomplete`.

## Why it matters

A fix in staging does not update a previously loaded launcher or operator. Earlier incident fixes for tiling, deadline observation and TTL diagnostics do not prove this handoff succeeded. Repeating the same queued request cannot repair a mismatched root or a hook writer that keeps downgrading its output. Keep the original process and claims safe until native successor proof exists; never loosen identity checks, change account routing or widen a timeout to hide the failure.

## How to apply

The launcher's existing `prepareSuLaunchEnvironment` now derives the home root only from the authenticated Codex launch envelope, requiring an absolute home whose session key matches its ADV id. An explicit contradictory root is refused. Inherited homes cannot supply that authority.

After successful canonical home repair, missing installed provenance/journal registrations are reconciled using `@papercusp/host-platform/codex-turn-hooks`, the same enrollment builder used by `writeCodexLockHooks`. Reconciliation requires intact same-owner config, diagnostics and existing hook ownership. Foreign owners, symlink hook documents, contradictory registrations and missing authority files remain refusals. It preserves unrelated hook events/settings, account configuration and native history. Repeated older-writer repairs must remain idempotent.

Use the normal managed launch/resume door to load current launcher code for already-running sessions; do not edit a live host's control metadata or treat a new source file as proof an older process adopted it. Verify the successor's exact native turn and carry delivery receipt. Release/gate ownership stays with its live custodian.

## Evidence and regression guards

`apps/operator/scripts/psu-launcher-codex-home-guard.test.ts` first failed both new isolated-root assertions, then passed 123 tests after the fix, including repeated older-writer repair and authority refusals. `packages/operator-core/lib/role-codex-home.test.ts` passed 145 tests with the shared enrollment builder. Source and verification follow-up: WI-6554700010051289. Related historical incidents: WI-6554700010049971, WI-6554700010044883, WI-6554700010027627. These focused results establish current source behavior; they are not a production shipment claim.
